references.text: Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before the assembly of Israel, the same reaction as here when the people bring complaints.
The glory of the Lord appears to the entire assembly, parallel to the revelation of God's glory in this text.
Moses and Aaron go to the tabernacle and the glory of the Lord is revealed, the same pattern as in this event.
The cloud covers the tabernacle and the glory of the Lord appears, a similar theophany at the tent of meeting.
The glory of the Lord fills the tabernacle, a foundational text on God's revelation of glory at the tent of meeting.
The glory of the Lord appears to the people at the tent of meeting, parallel to the revelation of God's glory.
The glory of the Lord fills the temple, a similar theophany as at the tent of meeting in the wilderness.
Abram fell on his face when God spoke to him, the same attitude of reverence shown by Moses and Aaron.
